title: GPU & Energy
description: USE view per card. Under -sm layer each layer's weights and KV slice live on one card; GPU1 holds the output layer and draft context and is the binding card. Energy comes from the NVML cumulative counter, never from integrating sampled power.

panels.title: GPU power from the energy counter, per card
panels.description: rate(nvml_gpu_energy_joules_total) per GPU (nvmlDeviceGetTotalEnergyConsumption / 1000), stacked; dashed line = enforced power limit sum. Counter-based rates do not miss sub-sample spikes (ML.ENERGY / Zeus method).

panels.title: Cumulative GPU energy (range)
panels.description: increase(nvml_gpu_energy_joules_total[$__range]) / 3600 per GPU over the dashboard time range, in watt-hours.

panels.title: Idle GPU power (1 h)
panels.description: llm:gpu_idle_watts:avg1h: mean energy-counter power over the last hour while llamacpp:requests_processing stayed 0 (both cards; the baseline J/token includes).

panels.title: Wh per 1k requests (1 h)
panels.description: llm:wh_per_1k_requests:rate1h: GPU Wh over the last hour × 1000 / requests completed in that hour (idle included). Needs ≥ 1 request.

panels.title: J per output token and J per request
panels.description: llm:joules_per_output_token:rate5m (left) and llm:joules_per_request:rate5m (right): GPU energy in 5 m / output tokens or completed requests in the same window. Traffic-gated (absent below 0.05 output tok/s), so gaps mean idle, not zero.

panels.title: GPU vs CPU package power
panels.description: llm:gpu_energy_watts:rate5m{scope="total"} (NVML counter) and llm:cpu_package_watts:rate5m (RAPL package counter). No wall meter exists on this host.

panels.title: Streaming-multiprocessor activity (GPM sm_util) vs nvidia-smi util
panels.description: nvml_gpu_gpm_ratio{metric="sm_util"}: fraction of the ~1 s window CUDA kernels actually ran on the SMs (NVML GPM, DCGM PROF_SM_ACTIVE analogue). nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio (legacy): fraction of time at least one kernel was running — saturates near 100 % on light work. Compare the two per card.

targets.expr: max by (index) (nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: GPM occupancy, graphics and memory bandwidth
panels.description: nvml_gpu_gpm_ratio: sm_occupancy (fraction of SMs in use), graphics_util (engine activity) and mem_bandwidth_util (memory bus activity — the decode bottleneck) per card.

panels.title: GPM compute precision mix
panels.description: nvml_gpu_gpm_ratio{metric=~"fp16_util|fp32_util|integer_util"}.

panels.title: GPM supported
panels.description: nvml_exporter_gpm_supported: 1 if GPM sampling works on the card.

panels.title: Power draw per card (display)
panels.description: nvml_gpu_power_watts: instantaneous NVML power per GPU (display only; energy rules use the counter).

panels.title: Memory: VRAM vs the 15,650 MiB wall
VRAM used per card
panels.description: nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes per GPU; red line = 15,650 MiB practical wall (card total 16,311 MiB). Under layer split the heavier card OOMs first. NVML framebuffer use (nvml_gpu_memory_used_bytes) overlaid when the exporter is up.

targets.expr: max by (index) (nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: Headroom to the wall
panels.description: (15,650 MiB − used) per card from nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes. Below ~500 MiB a deeper prefill can fail to allocate compute buffers.

targets.expr: 15650 * 1024 * 1024 - max by (index) (nvidia_smi_memory_used_bytes * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: Per-process VRAM
panels.description: nvml_gpu_process_memory_bytes: framebuffer used by each compute process, with its container resolved from the cgroup.

panels.title: PCIe TX / RX per card
panels.description: nvml_gpu_pcie_tx_bytes_per_second (positive) and nvml_gpu_pcie_rx_bytes_per_second (negative) from GPM. Layer split sends activations between cards over PCIe every token.

panels.title: PCIe link
panels.description: nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_current / _width_current against the maxima. Idle cards downtrain the link generation, so read it under load.

targets.expr: max by (index) (nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_current * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)
max by (index) (nvidia_smi_pcie_link_gen_max * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)
max by (index) (nvidia_smi_pcie_link_width_current * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)
max by (index) (nvidia_smi_pcie_link_width_max * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: PCIe replays (range)
panels.description: increase(nvml_gpu_pcie_replay_total[$__range]) per GPU: link-level retransmissions; non-zero means a marginal riser or slot.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu per card; dashed = slowdown limit reported by the driver as temperature_gpu_tlimit (degrees below the limit).

targets.expr: max by (index) (nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: Throttle time share
panels.description: rate() of the nvidia-smi clock-event counters per card: fraction of wall time under SW power cap (expected at 180 W), HW/SW thermal slowdown and HW power brake.

targets.expr: max by (index) (rate(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_counters_sw_power_cap_seconds[$__rate_interval]) * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)
max by (index) (rate(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_counters_hw_thermal_slowdown_seconds[$__rate_interval]) * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)
max by (index) (rate(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_counters_sw_thermal_slowdown_seconds[$__rate_interval]) * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)
max by (index) (rate(nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_counters_hw_power_brake_slowdown_seconds[$__rate_interval]) * on (uuid) group_left (index, name) nvidia_smi_gpu_info)

panels.title: XID events (range)
panels.description: increase(nvml_gpu_xid_events_total[$__range]) by GPU and XID code: driver-reported critical errors (e.g. 79 fallen off the bus, 13/31 app faults).

panels.title: GPU alerts
panels.description: Prometheus-managed alerts from rules/llm.rules.yml (no Alertmanager on this host; alerts surface only here). The table next to it reads ALERTS directly.
